svg.title: Snow report: 280 contributions in the last year
svg.desc: 280 contributions in the last year, current streak 2 days, longest streak 5 days, best day 27 on Oct 23, 2026. Drawn as a mountain range of weekly totals; the peak week (53, week of Oct 18, 2026) carries a summit cross. Updated Oct 27, 2026.
